Maze Generator & Game

Generate perfect mazes with DFS, navigate them with arrows/WASD or the on-screen pad, and reveal the solution path.

0
Moves

Guide the red dot to the green goal!

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a maze size — a fresh maze generates.
  2. Move the red dot with arrows/WASD or the pad.
  3. Reach the green goal square to win.
  4. Press Show Solution to see the shortest path.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are mazes generated?

Recursive-backtracker (depth-first search) carves a perfect maze — exactly one path between any two cells.

How do I move?

Arrow keys, WASD, or the on-screen direction pad for touch devices.

Which sizes are available?

Small (11×11), Medium (21×21), and Large (31×31) — a new maze generates when you change size.

Can I see the solution?

Press Show Solution to overlay the shortest path from start to finish in gold.
